hintsEn.AUS: A$ 70. The Passenger Movement Charge is included in the ticket price
hintsEn.AUT: € 12. Domestic flights like short distance, but including value added tax. Tax levied through carrier of flight. Since 1 September 2020 tax depending on distance system is abolished and a flat rate is applied. Information based on Flugabgabegesetz (FlugAbgG)
hintsEn.BGD: ৳ 500. Charges at land border exits. Must be paid in cash (taka) at any branch of Sonali Bank ; a bank booth is available at all land exits
hintsEn.BLZ: Land Borders Foreign Nationals: BZ$ 40 Belizean Nationals: BZ$ 0 Airports Foreign Nationals: BZ$ 75 Belizean Nationals: BZ$ 35
hintsEn.BMU: US$ 35. Although the passenger departure tax in Bermuda is levied to the owner of Airline for every departing passenger, this is squarely passed on to the passenger as part of the overall ticket fare. There are exceptions in case of children under 2 years, transit passengers and in some other cases. A tax of $35 is charged for every departing passenger. Also a Yacht arrival Tax in Bermuda is charged to the owner of the arriving yacht. Presently $35 is charged for each passenger arriving by the yacht
hintsEn.BRN: B$ 5. If the final destination is not Indonesia, Malaysia or the Philippines, then the tax is BN$12. If transiting through one of these countries, the higher tax rate still applies, even if the initial flight destination is located in Indonesia, Malaysia or the Philippines. Paid in cash at check-in
hintsEn.CAN: CA$ 0 to CA$ 40. Departure tax is in the form of an Airport Improvement Fee [AIF] and is added to the cost of the ticket. Ranges from $0–40 depending on the Canadian airport that you depart from
hintsEn.CHN: CN¥ 90. Charged to all visitors leaving by air. Fees are included in airline tickets
hintsEn.CRI: ₡ 14,500. Charged to all visitors leaving by air. Must be paid in cash (US dollars or colones), or is charged as a cash advance on a credit card. Departure taxes are included in most air ticket prices, depending on which airline
hintsEn.CUB: $MN 25. Included in air ticket price since April 2015
hintsEn.DEU: € 12.88 (band A countries) / € 32.62 (band B countries) / € 58.73 all other countries. for more details on Luftverkehrsteuergesetz (LuftVStG) see German air passenger taxes
hintsEn.DOM: RD$ 884.595. Paid in cash upon departure. Departure taxes are included in most air ticket prices, depending on which airline
hintsEn.ECU: US$ 27.15. Included in air ticket price
hintsEn.EGY: E£ 410. Charged to all visitors leaving by air starting from November 2019
hintsEn.FJI: FJ$ 100. Included in air ticket price
hintsEn.GBR: Between £ 13 (band A, lowest class) and £ 194 (band D, any other class). Varies according to the distance traveled and passenger class. See Air Passenger Duty
hintsEn.GUY: GY$ 4,000. Payable at the airport on departure
hintsEn.HKG: HK$ 120 by air HK$ 18 by ferry. Included in tickets. Refundable in some cases
hintsEn.HND: L 700. Only applies to air. Small land departure tax
hintsEn.IRN: 1st departure: ﷼ 9,000,000 2nd: ﷼ 15,000,000 3rd: ﷼ 22,000,000. Only applies to Iranian citizens and should be paid at the airports or Melli bank branches. The amount is incremental and depends on the number of departures in a solar year. Religious travels are taxed much less on second and third (and more) departures
hintsEn.JPN: ¥ 1,000. Effective Jan 7, 2019. Departure tax is charged to each passenger leaving the country by aircraft or ferry regardless of nationality
hintsEn.KHM: US$ 25. Included in airline tickets as of 2011
hintsEn.LBN: Economy Class: ل.ل 50,000 Business Class: ل.ل 110,000 First Class: ل.ل 150,000. From 22 August 2017 (Economy class tax was planned to be increased to 60,000 LBP but it was decided to keep it at 50,000 LBP)

hintsEn.MEX: Mex$ 1,160. All non-Mexican nationals must pay this fee, except those who have permanent resident status or who are connecting flights

Exemptions on Effective 1 September 2019. Exemptions: Babies or toddlers under the age of 24-months Passengers on transits not exceeding 12 hours
hintsEn.NLD: € 29.4. The air passenger tax rate for 2025, per passenger per flight
hintsEn.PAN: US$ 40. Charged to all visitors leaving by air. Included in airfare
hintsEn.PER: US$ 30.75. This is for travel to the United States. There are different fees for travel to other places
hintsEn.PHL: Full travel tax Economy class – ₱ 1,620 First class – ₱ 2,700 Standard Reduced travel tax Economy class – ₱ 810 First class – ₱ 1,350 Privileged Reduced travel tax Economy class– ₱ 300 First class – ₱ 400. To be paid in cash (peso or dollars) before departure. Travel tax can be paid through partner airlines; travel tax centers at airports, travel tax offices and satellite offices; or online. Full travel tax Filipino citizens Non-immigrant foreign passport holders who have stayed in the Philippines for more than one year) Standard Reduced travel tax Minors (from 2 years and one day to 12th birthday on date of travel) Accredited Filipino journalist whose travel is in pursuit of journalistic assignment Those authorized by the President of the Republic of the Philippines for reasons of national interest Privileged Reduced travel tax Legitimate spouse of an Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) Legitimate and unmarried children of an OFW below 21 years of age
hintsEn.SAU: ر.س 165. Departure tax is included in airfare
hintsEn.SWE: European destinations – kr 61 Medium range destinations – kr 255 Long range destinations – kr 408. As of 1 April 2018 the Departure tax aka the Swedish Aviation Tax is levied on commercial flights carrying passengers and departing from a Swedish airport. European destinations means inside Europe including domestic journeys. Medium range includes for example Saudiarabia, Iran and United States, while Long range are more distant destinations
hintsEn.THA: ฿ 700. Included in airline tickets as of 2007
hintsEn.TUN: د.ت 60. Some people are exempted from paying this tax
hintsEn.TUR: ₺ 1,250. Only applies to Turkish citizens. May be paid at airports or via online tax payment systems of the Turkish Revenue Administration and/or of the contracted banks. Children younger than 7, citizens with resident permits in other countries (RU work permit accepted too), and crew members of any commercial road transport, rail transport, ship transport, and aviation vehicles are exempt from payment
hintsEn.WSM: WS$ 65. Departure tax is included in airfare
